text.content:
The mayor who called in Arasaka.

Role: Mayor of Night City
Known for: Bringing Arasaka's supercarrier into Coronado Bay in 2070

As a city councilman, Rhyne asked Arasaka for help as NUSA troops closed in. After the Arvin Accord made Night City a free city, voters made him mayor by acclamation.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.16
